presets.label: Quadruped · Cancel before lift
presets.description: A live WASD crawl that can cancel a foot lift before it starts. Release during the weight shift to request a return to standing; airborne steps and reversals finish the current transfer.
presets.readiness: Experimental command response · same 1.25 mm/s crawl · native stop/resume checks pass · browser and timestep validation in progress.
presets.evidence: An optional shared Rust planner change preserves motor limits, physical components and student weights. It rechecks a stop or non-reversing command once support is qualified before lift-off. Canceled lifts earn no walking credit. An early reversal prototype exceeded a later motor command bound, so reversals retain the committed transfer. This does not establish physical stopping latency, useful walking speed, general terrain behavior or hardware accuracy.
